title: Conjugating an internal quotient tensor isomorphism
statement: For every ScalarSectionData c and internal tensor isomorphism b there is a section tensor isomorphism barB satisfying TensorSectionCondition a T c b barB. No representative normalization of c or b is required.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; ordinary scalar balancing: literature/stacks-project/sites-modules.tex, change-of-rings functor and tensor product sheaf, Tag 03EL.

proof.text: Precompose by the product of the fixed derived section equivalences. Conjugate b by the two derived tensor comparisons and c.derived, giving an explicit isomorphism of the precomposed functors.
Precomposition is fully faithful. Take its preimageIso, use map_preimage on components, and cancel the comparison isomorphisms to obtain TensorSectionCondition.
